members.name: window.DIMMING_OFF
members.doc: dimming mode off Dimming mode is used to control whether or not a mobile device should dim the screen after a period without user interaction.

members.name: window.DIMMING_ON
members.doc: dimming mode on Dimming mode is used to control whether or not a mobile device should dim the screen after a period without user interaction.

members.name: window.DIMMING_UNKNOWN
members.doc: dimming mode unknown Dimming mode is used to control whether or not a mobile device should dim the screen after a period without user interaction. This mode indicates that the dim mode can't be determined, or that the platform doesn't support dimming.

members.name: window.WINDOW_EVENT_DEICONIFIED
members.doc: deiconified window event This event is sent to a window event listener when the game window or app screen is restored after being iconified.

members.name: window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_GAINED
members.doc: focus gained window event This event is sent to a window event listener when the game window or app screen has gained focus. This event is also sent at game startup and the engine gives focus to the game.

members.name: window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_LOST
members.doc: focus lost window event This event is sent to a window event listener when the game window or app screen has lost focus.

members.name: window.WINDOW_EVENT_ICONIFIED
members.doc: iconify window event This event is sent to a window event listener when the game window or app screen is iconified (reduced to an application icon in a toolbar, application tray or similar).

members.name: window.WINDOW_EVENT_RESIZED
members.doc: resized window event This event is sent to a window event listener when the game window or app screen is resized. The new size is passed along in the data field to the event listener.

elements.name: window.event_data
elements.description: Width and height are present for window.WINDOW_EVENT_RESIZED and absent for other window events.

members.name: inset_left
members.doc: Inset from the left window edge.

members.name: inset_top
members.doc: Inset from the top window edge.

members.name: inset_right
members.doc: Inset from the right window edge.

members.name: inset_bottom
members.doc: Inset from the bottom window edge.

elements.name: window.set_listener
elements.description: Sets a window event listener. Only one window event listener can be set at a time.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: A callback which receives info about window events. Pass an empty function or nil if you no longer wish to receive callbacks.

elements.examples:
function window_callback(self, event, data)
    if event == window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_LOST then
        print("window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_LOST")
    elseif event == window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_GAINED then
        print("window.WINDOW_EVENT_FOCUS_GAINED")
    elseif event == window.WINDOW_EVENT_ICONIFIED then
        print("window.WINDOW_EVENT_ICONIFIED")
    elseif event == window.WINDOW_EVENT_DEICONIFIED then
        print("window.WINDOW_EVENT_DEICONIFIED")
    elseif event == window.WINDOW_EVENT_RESIZED then
        print("Window resized: ", data.width, data.height)
    end
end

function init(self)
    window.set_listener(window_callback)
end

elements.name: window.set_mouse_lock
elements.brief: set the locking state for current mouse cursor
elements.description:
Set the locking state for current mouse cursor on a PC platform.
This function locks or unlocks the mouse cursor to the center point of the window. While the cursor is locked,
mouse position updates will still be sent to the scripts as usual.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.doc: The lock state for the mouse cursor

elements.name: window.set_dim_mode
elements.brief: set the mode for screen dimming
elements.description: Sets the dimming mode on a mobile device. The dimming mode specifies whether or not a mobile device should dim the screen after a period without user interaction. The dimming mode will only affect the mobile device while the game is in focus on the device, but not when the game is running in the background. This function has no effect on platforms that does not support dimming.

elements.name: window.get_dim_mode
elements.brief: get the mode for screen dimming
elements.description: Returns the current dimming mode set on a mobile device. The dimming mode specifies whether or not a mobile device should dim the screen after a period without user interaction. On platforms that does not support dimming, window.DIMMING_UNKNOWN is always returned.

elements.name: window.get_size
elements.description: This returns the current window size (width and height).

elements.name: window.get_safe_area
elements.description:
This returns the safe area rectangle (x, y, width, height) and the inset
values relative to the window edges. On platforms without a safe area,
this returns the full window size and zero insets.

elements.name: window.get_mouse_lock
elements.description: This returns the current lock state of the mouse cursor

elements.name: window.get_display_scale
elements.description: This returns the content scale of the current display.

elements.name: window.set_title
elements.brief: set the title of the window
elements.description: Sets the window title. Works on desktop platforms.

elements.name: window.set_size
elements.brief: set the size of the window
elements.description: Sets the window size. Works on desktop platforms only.

elements.name: window.set_position
elements.brief: set the position of the window
